title: Leaking
body: Leaks from the bottom seam, water everywhere on my floor by morning.

title: Filthy corners
body: Hard to clean the reservoir, slime builds up in the corners within a week.

title: Pump died
body: The pump stopped working after three weeks and the cat had no water for a day.

title: Audible at night
body: The pump is noisy at night, I can hear it from the bedroom across the hall.

title: Cat loves it
body: My cat loves it and it is whisper quiet, refill once every four days.

title: 难清洗
body: 水箱很难洗，边角容易发霉，每次拆开都要刷半小时。

title: 底板渗水
body: 用了两周底部开始漏水，地板都湿了一大片。

title: Too small
body: Too small for two cats, I refill it twice a day which is annoying.

title: Flimsy lid
body: The plastic feels cheap and the lid does not click shut properly.

title: 不出水
body: 用了两个月泵就不出水了，拆开看里面全是毛絮。

title: Scares the dog
body: Loud buzzing noise, my dog is scared of it and refuses to drink.

title: Good but fiddly
body: Works well for the price, cleaning is a bit fiddly though.

title: Filter cost
body: Not worth the price, the filter needs replacing every two weeks and costs as much as the fountain.

title: 有点吵
body: 晚上有点吵，能听到嗡嗡的声音，放在卧室不太合适。

title: Overflowed
body: The water level sensor failed and it overflowed overnight, soaked the carpet.

title: Clogs fast
body: The filter clogs fast and cleaning it is a real chore every single week.

title: 安静好用
body: 猫咪很喜欢，出水也安静，清洗比想象中方便。

title: Motor died
body: Motor died within six weeks and there are no replacement parts available anywhere.

title: 做工粗糙
body: 做工一般，盖子扣不紧，边缘还有毛刺，摸着扎手。

title: Swimming pool
body: Great design, except my floor is now a swimming pool. The tank joint does not seal.
